message: Good news first: the emulation run came back with no failures. That means our design hangs together. All 8 components are connected, the flow is complete, and nothing in it contradicts our requirements. The status is blocked for a different reason. None of the IBM services we picked (Event Streams, Code Engine, watsonx.ai, Cloudant, Event Notifications) has a supported generator contract yet, and the two existing parts (the sensor producer and the operator) still need a plan for how we connect to them. So nothing could actually run locally. The only supported IBM contract today is private object storage, and switching to it would shrink our pipeline down to storage, which you've ruled out. So I'm leaving the diagram as it is. To close this gap, the product team needs to build native IBM support, starting with an Event Streams topic and dead-letter topic plus a Code Engine validator that keeps deviceId, timestamp and unit unchanged. This exact run can serve as the test case to reproduce it (artifact 3046e8dc…, revision 2). Before that work gets scoped, there's one choice that shapes the model and how we test it: do you have labelled examples of past anomalies, or should we start with an unlabelled scoring approach and accept more false alarms at first?
